name: B10-0500/2025 – After § 11 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: 11b. Calls on the Member States and the Commission to ensure that the new resources generated by this handling fee will support the work of authorities responsible for market surveillance, customs, consumer protection and digital services, so that they can better cope with the challenges related to illegal products and material while not putting the authorities’ agents under undue pressure and while respecting labour rights;
